messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile/tablet-friendly 3D incremental game with an omnidirectional tree of about 60 upgrade nodes.
- Include tap multipliers, upgrade multipliers, auto buyers, auto taps, simulation speedups, and rebirths.

## Requirements
- User requested a finished playable game without clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented Flourish as a single-file HTML canvas game with a stylized, depth-shaded 3D-like tree, touch/mouse orbit and zoom, and responsive mobile layouts.
- Tree has exactly 60 nodes: one heart, six roots, 30 branches, and 23 outer shoots.
- Added local autosave, capped offline earnings, audio toggle, help modal, and rebirth seasons that grant permanent everseed bonuses.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable game in `index.html`.
- Added six upgrade categories, connected node unlocks, purchase costs/effects, auto income, rebirth progression, and save/load.
